text: At the end of the day, a merchant asks one question: how much do I get?
prefix: At the end of the day, a merchant asks one question: how much do I get?

text: Every night the bank adds up the day before, for each website: what was paid, the fee, what was refunded, and the payout.
prefix: Every night the bank adds up the day before, for each website: what was paid, the fee, what was refunded, and the payout.

text: A business day runs from midnight to midnight in the settlement time zone, the same day that decides reversal or refund, so the two never disagree.
prefix: A business day runs from midnight to midnight in the settlement time zone, the same day that decides reversal or refund, so the two never disagree.

text: Paid counts payments paid that day and not reversed; refunded counts refunds made that day, whenever the payment was.
prefix: Paid counts payments paid that day and not reversed; refunded counts refunds made that day, whenever the payment was.

text: The payout is the net of what was paid, less what was refunded: the bank keeps its fee on a refund.
prefix: The payout is the net of what was paid, less what was refunded: the bank keeps its fee on a refund.

text: Building a day again replaces its rows, and never adds to them.
prefix: Building a day again replaces its rows, and never adds to them.

text: So every instance may run the job, and each night it rebuilds the last three days: a night the app was down is caught up.
prefix: So every instance may run the job, and each night it rebuilds the last three days: a night the app was down is caught up.

text: On the scheme's side, Humo finalises an e POS terminal's payments, and pays its returns back, only after the terminal is reconciled.
prefix: On the scheme's side, Humo finalises an e POS terminal's payments, and pays its returns back, only after the terminal is reconciled.

text: So the card module reconciles every Humo e POS terminal fifteen minutes before each clearing session, and once between eleven forty-five and midnight; a unique row per terminal and slot lets only the first instance run it.
prefix: So the card module reconciles every Humo e POS terminal fifteen minutes before each clearing session, and once between eleven forty-five and midnight; a unique row per terminal and slot lets only the first instance run it.

text: Behind each day is a CSV: every payment and refund, with its fee, card and RRN, and a refund as a negative line.
prefix: Behind each day is a CSV: every payment and refund, with its fee, card and RRN, and a refund as a negative line.

text: Every cell is quoted, because a website's name may hold a comma.
prefix: Every cell is quoted, because a website's name may hold a comma.

text: In the portal, the merchant sees each day and downloads its CSV; a day where refunds outweigh payments shows a negative payout.
